definitions.gloss: lucky day; auspicious day; most favorable day
definitions.explanation: The most auspicious day in the traditional Japanese six-day calendar cycle (六曜 rokuyo). Considered the best day for weddings, business openings, and other important events.

examples.japanese: {結婚式|けっこんしき}は{大安|たいあん}の{日|ひ}にした。
examples.english: We held the wedding on an auspicious day.

examples.japanese: {大安|たいあん}の{日|ひ}は{結婚式場|けっこんしきじょう}の{予約|よやく}が{取|と}りにくい。
examples.english: It's hard to book wedding venues on auspicious days.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいお{店|みせ}の{開店日|かいてんび}を{大安|たいあん}に{合|あ}わせて{決|き}めた。
examples.english: We chose the opening day for the new shop to coincide with an auspicious day.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
{大安|たいあん} is part of the {六曜|ろくよう} (six-day cycle) calendar system used in Japan for fortune-telling. The six days are: {大安|たいあん} (most lucky), {友引|ともびき} (partly lucky), {先勝|せんしょう} (morning lucky), {先負|せんぶ} (afternoon lucky), {赤口|しゃっこう} (mostly unlucky), and {仏滅|ぶつめつ} (most unlucky). Many Japanese calendars still include these designations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大安|たいあん}の{日|ひ} (an auspicious day)
- {大安|たいあん}に{合|あ}わせる (to schedule for a lucky day)
- {大安|たいあん}{吉日|きちじつ} (auspicious and lucky day — formal set phrase)
